steps.note: Finish stone counting for the row
thoughts: That slab looks like it wants a break.
Wind rattles the loose stones again.
Bellows still sigh when I pull.
Maybe I can add a leather strap.

steps.note: Stack a few dry logs for later
thoughts: Good to have extra wood before the wind picks up.

steps.note: Take a short break, watch the flames
thoughts: Hope the roof holds through the gust.

live_thought.text: Dry logs stack, wind whistles through cracks.
